meta.title: VRChat avatar supporter
meta.description: Lets the agent do VRChat avatar modification work: it reads scenes and prefabs without opening Unity, designs the change, applies it through generated Editor scripts in batch mode, and verifies the result. It can also make outfit, skin, hair and eye color variants from the avatar's layered PSDs and switch them from the menu (using PhotoCraft), and adjust body shape or remove body parts hidden under clothes without editing the FBX. Assumes Unity 2022.3.22f1, an activated licence, and VCC or ALCOM. It never uploads and never edits scene YAML directly.
